description: This file contains JavaScript functions for managing line items, including adding, deleting, and calculating product and service lines within a CRM module. It handles dynamic UI updates, calculations of totals, and interactions with external product data.

methods.name: insertLineItems
methods.description: Loads line items into the UI, creating product or service lines based on product data.

methods.name: insertProductLine
methods.description: Creates a new product line in the specified table, with input fields and validation.

methods.name: insertServiceLine
methods.description: Creates a new service line in the specified table, with input fields and validation.

methods.name: insertProductHeader
methods.description: Inserts header row for product lines.

methods.name: insertServiceHeader
methods.description: Inserts header row for service lines.

methods.name: insertGroup
methods.description: Creates a new group container with nested product and service tables, including totals.

methods.name: markGroupDeleted
methods.description: Marks a group as deleted and hides its UI elements.

methods.name: markLineDeleted
methods.description: Marks a line (product or service) as deleted and updates totals.

methods.name: calculateLine
methods.description: Calculates the total price, VAT, and updates related fields for a line item.

methods.name: calculateAllLines
methods.description: Recalculates all product and service lines.

methods.name: calculateTotal
methods.description: Calculates subtotal, tax, total amounts for a group or overall.

methods.name: set_value
methods.description: Sets a form field value with formatted number.

methods.name: get_value
methods.description: Retrieves and unformats a number from a form field.

methods.name: unformat2Number
methods.description: Converts formatted number string to numeric value.

methods.name: format2Number
methods.description: Formats a number into a string with currency or fixed decimal places.

methods.name: formatCurrency
methods.description: Formats a number as currency string.

methods.name: Quantity_format2Number
methods.description: Formats quantity input as number string.
